content.title: Why Digital Turbine Stock Skyrocketed This Week
content.summary: Digital Turbine stock rocketed higher after the company posted stronger-than-anticipated quarterly results on Tuesday.  Digital Turbine (NASDAQ: APPS) stock saw explosive gains after reporting quarterly results earlier this week.  The business posted non-GAAP (adjusted) earnings per share of $0.10 on sales of $119.15 million, beating the average analyst estimate's call for adjusted per-share earnings of $0.04 on revenue of $116.64 million.

content.title: Why Digital Turbine Stock Plummeted Today
content.summary: Digital Turbine stock saw a massive post-earnings rally on Tuesday, but its share price slipped as the week progressed.  Investors took profits on the stock today, and geopolitical risk factors also worked to push its share price lower.  Digital Turbine is guiding for strong adjusted EBITDA growth this year, but geopolitical dynamics could create valuation volatility.
